items.title: Vedanta dividend alert! Last day to buy shares of Anil Agarwal-led company for Rs 5/share dividend
items.description: The company last week declared the interim dividend, which marks its first payout since the stock adjusted for its mega demerger earlier this year. The total dividend payout will be Rs 1,955 crore. Vedanta is closely watched by investors for its consistent track record of dividend payments.

items.title: TCS dividend alert! Last day to buy IT major's shares for Rs 12 dividend
items.description: The company last week declared the interim dividend, along with the Q2 results that kickstarted the September quarter earnings season for the IT sector. The latest dividend comes after TCS paid an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share to its shareholders in July.

items.title: Positive Breakout: These 7 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, seven stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 12, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Bank of India declares Rs 575 crore exposure to Future Enterprises as fraud
items.description: The Bank of India has officially marked its ₹575 crore exposure to Future Enterprises as fraudulent. Previously categorized as a non-performing asset, this account has been sufficiently provisioned. Future Enterprises, helmed by Kishore Biyani, entered insolvency proceedings back in 2022, focusing on retail infrastructure development and managing a variety of subsidiaries and joint ventures across different sectors.

items.title: AMC stocks gain up to 33% in H1 FY27 despite market turmoil
items.description: Amid stock market fluctuations, listed asset management companies have successfully held their ground, thanks in part to robust retail investor support. Companies like Nippon Life India Asset Management recorded significant share price appreciation during the first half of FY27. Though SIP inflows dipped slightly from their peak levels, they retained a solid foundation, signaling ongoing investor confidence.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty fall 0.7% as oil surge erases early gains
items.description: On Monday, Indian equities dipped as crude oil prices surged dramatically after recent attacks on Saudi Arabia. The NSE Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex reversed their earlier positive trajectories, influenced by notable foreign selling. Additionally, worries over the rupee's stability and continual sell-offs from foreign investors decreased market optimism. A reported 1.2% rise in Brent crude intensified fears of potential supply interruptions.

items.title: Stocks in news: HCL Tech, RBL Bank, Nazara Tech, Hero Motors, Power Grid and IRCON
items.description: Indian stock markets struggled on Monday, as the Nifty 50 saw a considerable drop. The falls were attributed to increasing bond yields, consistent outflows from foreign institutional investors, and pervasive global concerns. Attention now shifts to forthcoming announcements from major players like HCL Technologies and RBL Bank, with quarterly earnings expected to influence investor outlook.

items.title: D-Street poised for positive start as GIFT Nifty signals gains
items.description: Benchmark Nifty encountered a decline of 0.7% on Monday, driven by growing geopolitical tensions. Market analysts foresee a cautious atmosphere in India, primarily due to volatile crude oil prices and the crisis in West Asia. Foreign portfolio investors exited the market, selling shares worth Rs 1,708 crore, whereas domestic institutional investors invested Rs 3,045 crore. The rupee's strength increased by 96 paise, marking its largest gain in six months.

items.title: IHC, First Abu Dhabi eye stake in Bandhan Bank promoter
items.description: Early investors GIC & IFC jointly hold 30% in Bandhan Financial Services (BFSL), keen to exit. PE funds tapped too to gauge strategic interest. BFSL, led by Bandhan founder Chandra Shekhar Ghosh, has been working with advisers Jefferies to find strategic investors for 25-32%.

items.title: Top 10 blue-chips’ share of India’s m-cap drops to lowest since 2017
items.description: India's top 10 listed blue-chip companies are experiencing a decline in market capitalisation share. This decline is attributed to sustained foreign portfolio investor selling and large-cap stock underperformance. The top 10 companies now account for around 17.65% of the total market capitalisation as of October 9. Despite this, domestic flows are supporting the broader market and smaller companies are outperforming large caps.

items.title: Stock Radar: South Indian Bank stock takes support above 20-DMA after hitting record highs in September; time to buy the dip?
items.description: South Indian Bank shares rebounded after testing their 20-day moving average, with technical indicators pointing to a positive trend. Choice Broking’s Kkunal V. Parar sees potential for the stock to move towards Rs 55–58, citing support near Rs 42, a rising channel pattern and positive momentum, while noting it remains below its 10-DMA.

items.title: Sunil Mittal gets highest French civilian award
items.description: The honour recognises Mittal's contributions to strengthening economic ties between France and India as well as his achievements in the telecommunications and digital infrastructure and satellite communications space.

items.title: A falling stock is not always cheap: Kotak explains the role of earnings and valuations
items.description: Kotak Institutional Equities argues that stock prices are driven by earnings expectations and PE multiples rather than market flows or liquidity. Rebutting myths about FPI outflows and IPOs draining secondary market cash, the brokerage highlights business fundamentals and mental DCF valuations as the true price drivers.

items.title: FM Sitharaman's LTCG tax remarks lift Sensex by 1,100 points. Can markets hope for a review?
items.description: Indian equities rallied on Tuesday, with the Sensex surging over 1,100 points after Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said discussions around long-term capital gains tax (LTCG) and securities transaction tax (STT) were ongoing. IT stocks also supported gains, led by HCL Tech and TCS. However, mixed broader-market trends, elevated crude prices and inflation concerns continued to temper investor sentiment.

items.title: Unique Picks: 10 stocks held by a single MF scheme in September; rally up to 225% in FY27 so far
items.description: ETMarkets analysed mutual fund portfolios to identify stocks held by only one mutual fund scheme. The initial screening for September 2026 identified 275 such stocks. The list was further narrowed to stocks in which equity mutual fund holdings exceeded Rs 10 crore as of September 2026, resulting in a final shortlist of 69 stocks.The share price performance of these stocks in FY27 so far has been largely positive. Around 11 stocks surged between 80% and 225% during the period, with seven more than doubling in value. Notably, each of these seven multibagger stocks was held by only one mutual fund scheme. (Data Source: ACE MF, ACE Equity).

items.title: Hitachi Energy, E2E Networks, Anant Raj, other AI-linked stocks slide up to 5% as global AI rout hits Indian markets
items.description: Indian AI- and energy-linked stocks decline as a global technology sell-off deepens, with South Korea’s KOSPI plunging amid intensifying competition in the AI sector. Investors reassess AI valuations following sharp losses in Asian semiconductor stocks.

items.title: Rethink the short term, but it is only about business in the long term: 5 mid-cap stocks with upside potential of up to 23%
items.description: Be clear-eyed about the short term, because we are not done with market pessimism. There may well be more to come, and that could give you better prices than today's. But the preparation has to be done now, not after the move. In the long term, the rule is a simple one: Know what you own, and know why you own it.

items.title: Rule out V-shaped recovery, markets can fall more, says PL Capital with Nifty 12-month target at 27,589
items.description: PL Capital remains cautious on the Nifty after its eight-week losing streak, ruling out a quick V-shaped recovery. The brokerage has trimmed earnings estimates but sees valuation comfort in largecaps, while flagging inflation, FII outflows and demand risks.

items.title: Paytm, Pine Labs, Mobikwik shares crash up to 7% as UPI MPR fee rollout delayed beyond Diwali
items.description: Shares of Paytm, Pine Labs dropped after NPCI delayed the rollout of merchant discount rate (MDR) fees on select UPI transactions beyond Diwali. The rollout, earlier scheduled for October 15, was expected to boost fintech companies’ earnings during the festive season. NPCI said the revised implementation date would be communicated to stakeholders soon.

items.title: Triveni Power Transmission lists on BSE, NSE following demerger from Triveni Engineering
items.description: Triveni Power Transmission Limited has listed on the BSE and NSE following its demerger from Triveni Engineering & Industries. The independent entity aims to sharpen its business focus and expand across industrial, marine and defence applications.

items.title: Surging bond yields wreak havoc on Dalal Street, but IMF sees more pain ahead. Why AI is one of the culprits
items.description: The IMF has flagged three risks to global financial stability: an AI-driven market correction, rising sovereign bond yields and cyberattacks. These threats could trigger broader financial stress, while high borrowing and tight market linkages may amplify their economic impact.

items.title: CoinSwitch Ventures goes global as BlackLane Capital, plans to back startups with cheques of up to $5 million
items.description: CoinSwitch’s investment arm, CoinSwitch Ventures, has rebranded as BlackLane Capital, expanding beyond crypto and Web3 to invest in early-stage startups across fintech, enterprise infrastructure, consumer applications and digital assets. The firm plans to invest up to $5 million per startup and aims to enable over $100 million in startup funding over the next five years through its investments and partner network. It has previously backed more than 26 startups under its Web3-focused mandate.

items.title: Nifty 50 at 26,500 in 4-5 months? Monarch Networth CEO points to 3 key triggers
items.description: Nifty 50 could reach 26,000-26,500 within four to five months, driven by cooling US Treasury yields, dollar weakness, and FII short covering, according to Monarch Networth Capital CEO Gaurav Bhandari. Strong monthly domestic inflows of Rs 31,000 crore provide additional support for valuation re-rating.

items.title: AI investors or casino gamblers? What Broadcom CEO Hock Tan said that sparked sharp global AI selloff
items.description: Global AI stocks plunged after Broadcom CEO Hock Tan warned that investors are treating artificial intelligence like gambling, raising concerns about excessive valuations and unsustainable spending. He questioned OpenAI’s long-term profitability despite strong revenue growth. South Korea’s Kospi and Japan’s Nikkei declined, while Indian IT stocks rallied amid the global technology selloff.

items.title: Rupee makes stunning comeback: What is RBI’s 4-step plan?
items.description: The rupee staged a stunning comeback, gaining nearly Re 1 against the dollar after the RBI rolled out a four-step package to curb currency pressure. From a dedicated dollar window to tighter forex derivatives rules and higher hedging costs, here’s what the RBI’s moves mean for the rupee — and whether the relief rally can last.

items.title: Mukul Agarwal adds 470% multibagger to Rs 8,000 crore portfolio, trims KRN Heat exposure
items.description: Ace investor Mukul Agarwal added a 1.2% stake in precision engineering firm Apsis Aerocom, which has surged 470% since its March 2026 debut, to his Rs 8,000 crore portfolio. Meanwhile, he trimmed his stake in KRN Heat Exchanger following a 61% rally over the past year.

items.title: Jio IPO may trigger Reliance’s next big re-rating. Why Religare sees 47% upside
items.description: Reliance Industries could see a valuation re-rating as Jio Platforms’ proposed Rs 30,000 crore IPO brings greater transparency to its digital business. Religare has a target price of Rs 1,696 on the stock, implying 46.7% upside from its current market price.

items.title: Warren Buffett became a millionaire at 32. What he advises youth trying to copy his success
items.description: Warren Buffett became a millionaire at 32 and has inspired many through his investing journey. He emphasizes starting young and the importance of compounding over time. Buffett used the metaphor of a 'snowball' to illustrate building wealth gradually. He recently transitioned leadership at Berkshire Hathaway and reflected on his career. Buffett expressed confidence in the company's future and his continued role as a shareholder.

items.title: NSEIX, London Stock Exchange sign pact to deepen India-UK market links
items.description: NSE IFSC and the London Stock Exchange have signed an MoU to explore dual listings, cross-listings, new financial products and cross-border trading connectivity between GIFT City and London. The proposed collaboration could expand global investor access for Indian issuers, improve market connectivity and strengthen GIFT IFSC’s role as an international financial hub.

items.title: Sebi proposes review of framework for monitoring utilization of issue proceeds
items.description: Sebi has invited public comments on recommendations to review rules governing the monitoring and disclosure of issue proceeds by listed companies. The consultation paper, based on a working group’s report, also covers penalties for non-compliance and related-party transaction provisions. Stakeholders can submit comments and supporting rationale by November 3, 2026.

items.title: Market Trading Guide: Balrampur Chini Mills among 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday
items.description: Indian equities advanced on Tuesday as stronger-than-expected technology earnings boosted confidence in corporate profit growth and lifted benchmark-heavy large-cap stocks. Analysts say a strong IT-led start and expectations of decent overall Q2 corporate performance suggest the market is pricing in resilience despite a challenging external environment.Here are 4 stock recommendations for Wednesday

items.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
items.description: Sensex and Nifty rallied over 1.5% on Tuesday, adding around Rs 5 lakh crore to the market capitalisation of listed companies. Investors will track global cues, Q2 earnings, active stocks, buying and selling trends, and key technical levels on Wednesday as markets assess the sustainability of the sharp rebound.

items.title: Two Trades for Today: An online marketplace for a 7.85% gain, a mid-cap BPO stock for a rise of almost 6%
items.description: Our technical analysts identify select stocks every trading day that may gain momentum even in volatile markets. Here are the technical calls for today.

items.title: PTC Industries among 4 stocks hitting 52-week highs; rally up to 15% in a month
items.description: Sensex surged 1,109 points to close at 73,033 on Tuesday. Amid the market rally, four stocks from the BSE 500 index touched fresh 52-week highs, reaching their highest levels in the past year. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the previous 12 months and can indicate increased investor interest and trading activity.

items.title: The best financial advice is often to do nothing, says Value Research CEO Dhirendra Kumar
items.description: Value Research CEO Dhirendra Kumar says good financial advice often means helping investors avoid unnecessary transactions and impulsive decisions. Speaking at the Global Financial Planners Summit Team 2026, he stressed the importance of financial education at home, disciplined investing and understanding products before making decisions with long-term financial consequences.

items.title: Market wrap:  HCL Tech, TCS, Kotak Bank, Eternal top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Tuesday
items.description: Indian equity markets rallied over 1.5% on Tuesday, with the Sensex rising 1,109 points and the Nifty 50 gaining 358 points. IT stocks led the advance, with HCL Tech and TCS topping the gainers’ lists. Kotak Mahindra Bank, Eternal and Maruti Suzuki were among the notable laggards.

items.title: 70% women control portfolios, but none received structured financial training, study finds gap in wealth succession
items.description: A study by Equirus Wealth finds that 70% of women have the final say over their investment portfolios, yet none of the respondents received structured financial training. Four in ten assumed financial responsibilities after a major life event, highlighting gaps in financial preparedness and wealth succession among Indian families.

items.title: RBI to continue efforts to curb rupee volatility; external factors driving currency fall: FM
items.description: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman mentioned the Reserve Bank of India’s ongoing efforts to stabilize the rupee's value. She noted that the rupee has significantly depreciated due to global uncertainties, despite India's strong economic fundamentals. Sitharaman highlighted recent measures by the RBI that helped the rupee appreciate temporarily in value. She also acknowledged the healthy debate around tax rationalization in the securities market.

items.title: Sebi notifies PMS rules; broadens investment avenue for portfolio managers, introduces PRIM route
items.description: Sebi has announced a new Portfolio Management Services framework effective from April 1, 2027. This framework permits portfolio managers to invest in IPOs, primary market debt, and various overseas securities. Portfolio managers can also offer advisory services related to unlisted securities for large investors. Furthermore, a Portfolio Managers Route for Investing in Mutual Fund units will facilitate investment in direct plans.
